niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces with strong, explicit structure and guidance, clear visual hierarchy, visible actions, rounded polished components, and layouts that feel organized rather than ambiguous. They frequently favor readable, well-separated sections, prominent CTAs, modular cards, and interfaces that make options immediately visible. Aesthetically, they often like soft, polished, approachable styling with depth, rounded corners, and controlled whitespace, though in some contexts they also respond positively to immersive dark themes when hierarchy and structure remain strong.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong hierarchy with prominent titles or hero values, visible subtitles/section labels, readable supporting text, and clearly separated content blocks.
Prefers layouts that show full structure up front: visible inputs, explicit rows/sections/cards, modular organization, and complete rather than sparse or ambiguous compositions.
Prefers obvious completion and action controls such as visible primary buttons, clear top-right or top-bar actions, and navigation patterns that make next steps easy to find.
Prefers breathing room, open spacing, contained content areas, and reduced crowding over tightly packed or cluttered layouts.
Prefers rounded cards, pill-shaped buttons, softer edges, and an overall polished, friendly component treatment rather than square or utilitarian UI.
Prefers layered card-based presentation with shadows, translucency, overlays, and clear panel separation instead of flat monolithic surfaces.
Prefers interfaces that guide the task with clear prompts, visible option sets, integrated controls, helper cues, and direct access to tools instead of hidden or indirect interaction patterns.
